prior_entry_value_candidate: synthetic only; not launched; retained unchanged
scope: entry only, separate bid and ask regressors, shared joint portfolio and neutral keeper
entry_rule: post iff predicted post-minus-wait value > 0, else reconsider on the next 50ms decision; no forced retry
resting_rule: all arms keep, subject to identical engine safety and cap constraints; combine with learned keeper only in a separately declared experiment
features: 51 existing causal entry features plus 17 direction-aligned market signals and signed known inventory; 69 total; separate models per side, price level included
target: one changed entry action versus neutral post/keep path; whole joint portfolio cash plus inventory at common 60.2s terminal; 30-share order; value in cents per original share
continuation: neutral post/keep on both branches; WAIT target defers one decision only; repeated learned waiting is tested by sequential replay, not claimed optimal
population: one row per neutral entry generation, 1/4 deterministic hash sample independent of outcome, exclusions and zero-fill targets retained
model: two LightGBM regressors, pinned PULL-DEPTH parameters, 200 rounds, target clipped +/-10; at least 200 actions, two days and 20 nonzero targets per side, no tuning
training: five chronological folds; train strictly before calibration day before test; fixed zero threshold, no calibration/test outcome selection
development_screen: positive absolute M50 gross PNL with/without under-100ms fills; beat each entry comparator pooled and on at least 4/5 days at each clock under both age treatments; no higher M50 integrated squared inventory than each comparator
null: 500 selections matched on UTC day, side, hour and positive action count; local action value only, never portfolio PNL
intervals: 1000 UTC-day bootstraps only after five complete replay days, descriptive consumed-data intervals
resource_plan: codex core8 via run_light, one worker, 2GiB RSS guard; older size queue yields after its current stage and resumes automatically after this smoke
limitations: Neutral reference entry actions do not cover every repeated-wait state
One-step target may mostly measure a 50ms queue race: inspect support before full run
Neutral keeper is for entry isolation; does not establish combined strategy performance
Known inventory affects caps/value but no extra inventory penalty was introduced
Inherited gross simulated values exclude fees/rebates; queue/fill assumptions unvalidated
SCHEDULED/TIMER use the inherited LODO guard; exploratory comparisons only
